# Artemis

> Artemis is a free, open-source (MIT) AI job search agent that runs on your own computer. It finds jobs and freelance projects matching your resume, finds the recruiter or hiring manager, writes a personal cold email or proposal, sends it from your own Gmail after you approve it, and follows up on day 4 and day 7 until they reply.

- Source code: https://github.com/Manideep-Ai-ai/artemis-job-agent
- Website: https://manideep-ai-ai.github.io/artemis-job-agent/
- Install: `pip install -e .` from the repo, then run `leadhunter web` and open http://127.0.0.1:8765
- Language: Python 3.10+, FastAPI dashboard, SQLite, no JavaScript build

## Key facts

- Lead sources: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee job boards, Remotive, Arbeitnow, Hacker News "Who is hiring?", Freelancer.com, and any pasted job link.
- Finds contacts through web search (Brave, Tavily or SearXNG) and email patterns (optionally Hunter.io). It never logs into LinkedIn.
- Writing uses AI (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI or offline Ollama) or built-in templates, plus the user's own projects and notes.
- Safety: every first email needs approval, max 10 emails a day (hard limit 20), weekdays and working hours only, stops on reply or bounce.
- Privacy: resume, contacts and API keys stay on the user's computer. No server, no account, no telemetry.
- Not a mass-apply bot: it does not fill in job application forms and does not automate LinkedIn or freelance sites.
